The recovery acceptance drill has completed successfully through all planned phases:

The Python program read the authorized `authorized-source` dataset, extracted all measurement field values, computed the exact median, and wrote the result to rows.jsonl.

This value represents the exact median computed from all 4 records in the authorized dataset. For an even number of values (n=4), the median is the average of the two middle values when sorted.
